published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The idleETH is not increased correctly, allowing the attacker to call the bringUnusedETHBackIntoGiantPool() function to steal ETH.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Increment the idleETH value accordingly in the bringUnusedETHBackIntoGiantPool() function.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The idleETH is not incremented when returning ETH.
